
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the SGD loss function string associated with an SGD loss function
    enumeration constant.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: integer
        Loss function enumeration constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Loss function string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}(
    ... {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/loss-function-str2enum}}(
    ... 'epsilon-insensitive' ) )
    'epsilon-insensitive'

    --------
